card.name: Inside words starting with De or Des
card.fires_on: Fragments partway through a word or name that begins with De, Der, Des or AD, such as the 'el' in derelict or 'MP' in ADEMPAS. It fires before the word is finished.

modes.description: The 'el' piece inside the word derelict.

modes.label: Names and brand names
modes.description: Middle pieces of surnames or capitalised brand names starting with De, Des or ADE.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of an unfinished word or name that starts with De or Des, like derelict or Ademp-as.
